commentary.text: 90+7' Francisco Maeso is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.
90+5' Iker Benito (Osasuna) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Francisco Maeso no option but to blow his whistle.
90+4' Raul Garcia (Osasuna) moves forward and unleashes a thunderous shot from distance that flies well over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Girona.
90+3' Some patient build-up play from Girona as they look to unlock the defence.
90+1' 4 - 0 Goal! Donny van de Beek plays a pass to the feet of Cristhian Stuani (Girona) and he shoots low into the back of the net from inside the box. It's 4:0.
90' There will be a minimum of 6 min. of added time.
89' Miguel Gutierrez (Girona) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort.
88' Raul Garcia (Osasuna) is adjudged offside.
88' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Girona, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
87' Francisco Maeso couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Donny van de Beek (Girona) and blew his whistle. Osasuna have a free kick from a promising distance.
86' The linesman raises his flag. Miguel Gutierrez (Girona) is adjudged offside.
85' Vicente Moreno prepares a substitution. Lucas Torro is replaced by Javier Martinez (Osasuna).
83' Girona fail to score from a corner as Sergio Herrera (Osasuna) leaps to collect the ball.

83' Donny van de Beek (Girona) attempts to find one of his teammates with a sweet pass into the box, but one of the defending players reacts well and intercepts the effort. The ball goes out for a corner. Girona can continue in their attacking effort.
81' Michel has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Portu (Girona) replacing Viktor Tsygankov.
81' Substitution. Bryan Gil is replaced by Donny van de Beek (Girona).
79' Bryan Gil (Girona) slips past one challenge, but is unable to feed a low pass into the path of one of his teammates. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Osasuna.
78' Bryan Gil (Girona) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear. The ball has crossed the sideline. Girona are taking a throw-in.
75' A cooling break is underway.
74' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Yaser Asprilla (Girona) replaces Abel Ruiz.
73' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Pablo Ibanez (Osasuna).
73' A spell of possession for Osasuna in an attempt to control the game.
69' Girona quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
69' Decent spell from Girona here and they keep the pressure on until one of the defending players steps in. The ball is out of play. Girona win a corner kick.
68' The substitution has been made. Iker Benito (Osasuna) has replaced Bryan Zaragoza.
68' Girona can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.

67' Abel Ruiz (Girona) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it. The linesman makes the right call and Girona will have a corner.

65' Abel Ruiz (Girona) beats the defender to the lofted pass inside the box, but can't control his shot and it flashes well wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Osasuna.
64' Bojan Miovski comes off the pitch to be replaced by Cristhian Stuani (Girona).
64' Michel has decided to make a change. Oriol Romeu (Girona) replaces Yangel Herrera.
62' Yangel Herrera (Girona) is having a really tough time right now. We are about to find out how serious his injury is.
61' Yangel Herrera (Girona) jumps into a tackle and Francisco Maeso signals a foul.
59' The referee allows time for a substitution. Aimar Oroz will be replaced by Pablo Ibanez (Osasuna).
59' Here is a change. Jon Moncayola is going off and Vicente Moreno gives the last tactical orders to Ruben Garcia (Osasuna).
58' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Raul Garcia (Osasuna) will replace Ante Budimir.
56' 3 - 0 Abel Ruiz (Girona) collects a good pass and slams the ball from mid-range into the top right corner, giving the goalkeeper no chance.
55' Jon Moncayola (Osasuna) sends a cross into the box, but Paulo Gazzaniga comes off his line to gather the ball.
53' 2 - 0 Goal! Viktor Tsygankov (Girona) was in the right place at the right time to get to the rebound inside the box and gleefully rifles the ball into the right side of the goal. It's 2:0.
51' A pass by Yangel Herrera (Girona) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end. The linesman signals a throw-in for Osasuna.
50' Yangel Herrera (Girona) is penalised after knocking an opponent down.
49' Miguel Gutierrez (Girona) makes a driving run into the box but he cannot work any space for a shot. The ball goes out of play and Osasuna will have a goal kick.

48' Wasted effort! Viktor Tsygankov (Girona) drives to the edge of the box after picking up a rebound, but his shot is tame and bends well wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Osasuna will have a goal kick.
47' We can have a look at the statistics now, particularly the total attempts – 4:0.
46' Ante Budimir (Osasuna) makes a rough challenge and Francisco Maeso blows his whistle for a foul.
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+5' The end of the first half.
45+3' One of the players from Osasuna times his run too early and the referee blows his whistle for offside.

45+2' Abel Ruiz (Girona) is first to react to a lofted pass from Bryan Gil, but fires his header miles over the bar from near the penalty spot. The ball goes out of play and Osasuna will have a goal kick.
45+2' Viktor Tsygankov (Girona) fails to deliver a decent cross from the corner and the ball goes out of play.

45+1' Girona play a few nice passes from player to player, but their possession doesn't last long as an opposition player intercepts a pass. The referee blows his whistle, Girona are awarded a corner kick.
45' 4 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
45' Francisco Maeso interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Aimar Oroz (Osasuna).
43' Alejandro Frances (Girona) fizzes over a cross which doesn't cause any problems. The ball is out of play. Osasuna will have a throw-in.
42' One of the defending players blocks a long-range shot which was unleashed by Bojan Miovski (Girona).
41' An opponent rises to his feet after being downed by Bojan Miovski (Girona). Francisco Maeso saw the sliding tackle and blows for a foul.
40' Bryan Zaragoza (Osasuna) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
38' The linesman raises his flag for offside before Miguel Gutierrez (Girona) heads on.
36' Bryan Zaragoza (Osasuna) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
34' 1 - 0 It's in the back of the net! Viktor Tsygankov plays it into the box, and Bryan Gil (Girona) gets on the end of the cross to put it inside the left post. 1:0.
30' It’s time for the cooling break for the players to take on some fluids. It’s hot out there!
30' Bojan Miovski (Girona) is offside and the linesman raises his flag.
29' Alejandro Frances (Girona) flights in the cross, but the defender is alert and clears to safety.
27' Francisco Maeso blows his whistle and it's Abel Ruiz (Girona) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee. Another situation results in a direct free kick for Osasuna.
26' A long pass, executed by David Lopez (Girona), missed the precision to reach his teammates. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Osasuna.
24' Bryan Gil (Girona) tries to pass the ball into the penalty area but it's blocked.
23' Girona work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.

22' Bryan Gil (Girona) finds himself in space on the edge of the box and smashes a glorious looking effort towards the top left corner, but Sergio Herrera thwarts him with a great two-handed save. It will be a corner kick for Girona.
21' Sergio Herrera (Osasuna) fails to find a teammate across the pitch with a long ball. It's a throw-in for Girona.
20' A cross into the box from Juan Cruz (Osasuna) is cleared.
19' David Lopez (Girona) sends in a pass which fails to reach any of his teammates. The ball is out of play. Osasuna will take a throw-in.
18' Moi Gomez (Osasuna) makes a bad challenge and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
18' The ball possession is 77:23.
17' Francisco Maeso blows his whistle after Yangel Herrera (Girona) brings one of his opponents down with a strong tackle.

15' Viktor Tsygankov (Girona) meets a delivery on the edge of the penalty area and shoots towards to the bottom left corner. He didn't put enough power into the effort, though, and Sergio Herrera pulls off an easy save.
14' The game is interrupted. Ante Budimir (Osasuna) has violated the rules in the battle for the ball. No protests or gestures are being made as he is quite aware of what he did.
13' Miguel Gutierrez (Girona) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Sergio Herrera, who smothers the ball.
13' The defence is alert as they clear a dangerous cross from Ivan Martin (Girona).
11' Abel Ruiz (Girona) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit chip pass.
9' Dangerous play by Daley Blind (Girona). Francisco Maeso blows his whistle for a foul.
8' Bojan Miovski (Girona) is caught offside after the linesman raises his flag.
7' David Lopez (Girona) sends a long ball in, but Sergio Herrera comfortably gathers the ball.
6' Francisco Maeso has a clear sight and sees a foul from Alejandro Frances (Girona).
5' Moi Gomez (Osasuna) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender.
4' Bryan Gil (Girona) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Sergio Herrera intercepts the ball.
3' Girona hold the ball and display nice passing from player to player.
2' The linesman signals that Bojan Miovski (Girona) is offside and the referee confirms the decision.
1' The first half has started.
Girona will kick-off.
